name: tubeforge
description: TubeForge — YouTube video/audio downloader, playlist processor, AI study mode and FFmpeg clip studio.

scripts.setup:ytdlp: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const os=require('os');const f=os.platform()==='win32'?'yt-dlp.exe':'yt-dlp';execSync(`curl -L --fail -o bin/${f} https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/${f}`,{stdio:'inherit'});if(os.platform()!=='win32')execSync('chmod +x bin/yt-dlp');console.log('yt-dlp installed to ./bin')"
